raw_response:
Answer: C
Reason: The chest X-ray demonstrates complete opacification of the left hemithorax with contralateral tracheal deviation to the right, which is characteristic of a massive pleural effusion exerting mass effect. Atelectasis or lung collapse would cause ipsilateral (leftward) deviation, while pneumothorax would present as radiolucency rather than opacity.
